Package org.frc5411.lib.mechanism.actuator.module

Class Module<Placement extends Enum<?>>

java.lang.Object
org.frc5411.lib.mechanism.actuator.module.Module<Placement>
All Implemented Interfaces:
edu.wpi.first.util.sendable.Sendable, Closeable, AutoCloseable, Actuatable<edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModuleState,edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModulePosition>, Component<edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModulePosition>
public abstract class Module<Placement extends Enum<?>> extends Object implements Actuatable<edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModuleState,edu.wpi.first.math.kinematics.SwerveModulePosition>

Module

Describes an abstract Swerve Module, i.e. any device that has one, a translational actuator and two, a rotational actuator, and can be commanded to a given reference of type state, and @{link Report report} back a position from measured values.
